span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Presentation of a prime activates its concept, and that activation spreads automatically along associative pathways in the semantic network to related concepts, so the related target is already pre-activated when it appears.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: The haemodynamic decrease for related pairs arises because pre-activation lowers the demand on semantic memory retrieval and selection, so less neural work is needed than for unrelated pairs.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: The shared right fronto-temporal deactivation is attributed to the easier semantic processing of associatively related concepts, an ease that does not depend on which modality delivered the prime.

span.label: A NULL WHERE THE DESIGN EXPECTED A DIFFERENCE: `Quotation withheld` A picture priming a word behaves like a word priming a word. Set beside Chen2018, tagged earlier tonight - which separated two cross-modal primes by their time courses - this says the modality BOUNDARY itself costs nothing, while what crosses it still can
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE SHORT SOA IS A CONTROL AND THE ALTERNATIVE IS NAMED: `In order to avoid STRATEGIC INFLUENCE OR EXPECTANCY which can affect priming‐specific patterns of activation ... we wanted to use fast, automatic, implicit processing, i.e., semantic priming with an short stimulus onset asynchrony.` The SOA is not a parameter, it is a fence - it makes strategy impossible rather than unlikely. Eighth record this sitting where a time course is load-bearing, and the first where it is used as a CONTROL rather than reported as a result
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: `response suppression` DEFINED BY SCOPE rather than by mechanism: it is `a special form of BOLD response deactivation, response enhancement a special form of BOLD activation IN THE CONTEXT OF SEMANTIC PRIMING EXPERIMENTS IN AN fMRI SETTING`. The definition carries its own boundary - the same neural word means this only here - which is exactly the move this corpus exists to record
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A SAMPLING DECISION WITH ITS REASON, AND ITS COST: `Quotation withheld` The rationale is stated and is statistical rather than theoretical - homogeneity bought at the price of generalising to half the population. Worth a row because the trade is made explicit rather than left to be noticed by a reader

span.label: cross‐modal —distinct-from→ unimodal
span.note: differs in: WHERE IN THE BRAIN, NOT HOW MUCH - both produce a behavioural priming effect and the comparison of the two revealed NO behavioural difference, while the neural suppression sits in bilateral fronto-parietal regions for unimodal and in the right inferior frontal gyrus for cross-modal · strength of the relation: 0.85 — Weighted 0.85 rather than higher because the distinction is NEUROANATOMICAL ONLY - behaviourally the paper reports no difference at all, and an edge read without that qualifier would overstate the separation. The null has its own sense row.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: cross‐modal —operationalised-as→ response suppression
span.note: strength of the relation: 0.9 — The neural effect is a DEACTIVATION - less BOLD signal for related than for unrelated pairs - so the priming benefit shows up as the brain doing less. Recorded because the sign is counterintuitive and a reader meeting `suppression` in a priming context needs it.
